g.text: OXPHOS, complex I, and protein degradation pass BH FDR < 0.05; translation and mTORC1 are contextual
U1-U2: upstream context; D1-D3: minimum downstream steps
D3 paths to all 14 observed query hits
All model edges among displayed nodes are retained
Display threshold >=1/5 is a coverage choice, not a significance cutoff
Thick black border: mitochondrial query hit at >=1/5
Node size and x/5 show neighborhood recurrence
U1-U2 nodes are upstream context; D1-D3 nodes lie downstream; arrows follow the Bayesian-network direction
